preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have been authorized by owner)
At least 2 minutes must have passed since last lunaburn call (lastSync + 2 minutes < block.timestamp)
Liquidity pool must contain LUNAINU tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the lunaburn() function with percent_base1000 parameter set to 50 (maximum 5% of LP tokens). This will transfer up to 5% of the liquidity pool tokens from the pair contract directly to the owner's wallet. Ensure at least 2 minutes have passed since the last lunaburn call by checking the lastSync timestamp. The attack can be repeated every 2 minutes to continuously drain liquidity pool tokens.
